backseat_ride.name: Sunday Drive
backseat_ride.role_title: a joyful passenger leaning out of a car window
backseat_ride.pose_sentence: The {pronoun} is leaning boldly out of the passenger-side car window, front paws draped over the door panel, head fully outside the car and facing forward into the wind. The body is angled outward and downward, chest resting on the window frame — the lower body and hind legs remain inside the car, completely out of frame. The camera angle is low and slightly from the side, looking up at the subject against the open road.
backseat_ride.props_sentence: A pair of dark wayfarer sunglasses is worn correctly over the eyes — lenses covering both eyes, nose bridge resting on the snout, temples hooked behind the ears. The glasses sit low on the face at eye level, not pushed up on the forehead or top of the head. The car door and window frame are visible beneath the front paws.
backseat_ride.environment: viewed from just outside and slightly below the car window — the open door panel and chrome trim in the foreground, and stretching behind the subject a long straight highway road disappearing into the horizon, flanked by trees and open landscape with a wide golden sky
backseat_ride.lighting: Warm sunset backlight from low on the horizon directly ahead, casting a golden rim glow around the subject's head and shoulders, with soft warm haze over the road behind.
